## Summary

Describe the user or architecture outcome, why it is needed, and which owner
now carries the responsibility. Identify intentional compatibility changes.

## Evidence and remaining limits

List the commands and manual checks actually observed, their relevant source,
build, or platform identity, and the behavior each establishes. Use
`.agents/project.md` (Verification selection) and `docs/DEVELOPMENT.md`
(Verification by task) to select checks.
Distinguish fresh results from explicitly attributed reusable evidence.

For documentation or workflow changes, check the affected structure, claims,
links, discovery, and host configuration; do not claim a product suite or
physical Windows result that was not run. For behavior changes, name any
remaining unverified obligation and the acceptance step required to resolve it.

## Platform evidence

Hardware decode, HDR, libmpv, native presentation, DirectComposition, physical
input/accessibility, and runnable package claims require their relevant Windows
evidence. Stock-engine compilation and synthetic widgets establish different
facts. Preserve the exact identities and limitations of historical evidence.

## Private data

Confirm the diff and attached evidence exclude credentials, tokenized URLs,
private media data, and unredacted diagnostics. Do not paste sensitive data
into the PR in order to demonstrate this check.
